target_customer: Gamers who want AI-made game mashups and mods, and AI researchers who need programmable games for RL and evals
problem: Combining or modifying games is technically hard for players, and RL researchers lack customizable game environments.
business_model: Free consumer launcher plus B2B tools for RL and evals (Melty Gym, Net, MCP); pricing not found
product_category: Game mashup launcher and programmable game environments

founders.name: David Miller
previous_startups: AI coach for gamers, reached 100K users before being banned, per YC page
founders.background_notes: Left high school at 18 per the YC page. Education and employers not listed.

competitors.name: Universal Modder
competitors.what: Claude Code plugin that mods PC games using reverse engineering and generated assets

competitors.name: PatchCraft
competitors.what: AI game mod creator platform for shareable mods
competitors.traction_then: Listed as an idea page; traction not stated

competitors.name: Vibe-coded AI mashup mods
competitors.what: Viral individual mashups such as Minecraft in Elden Ring
competitors.traction_then: Reported as taking over gaming Twitter

technical_complexity.rationale: An AI engine that decompiles and reworks existing games, adds 256-player multiplayer and works across titles is hard engineering, and legal and security trust issues compound it.

defensibility.rationale: Coding agents let anyone attempt mods, and publishers can enforce IP once mashups become public products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found; the main pressure so far is backlash over terms and privacy.

market_need_then: AI mashup clips went viral in 2026 (Decrypt, Minecraft inside Elden Ring demos), and the YC page claims 3.5K mashups played by 170K players.

identity.visual_style: Not described beyond the blue M

branding.brand_signature: 'Mashup any game' and viral mashup clips such as Minecraft in Elden Ring.
branding.community_and_virality: Discord server and X account @meltylauncher; coverage by GamesRadar, Dexerto and games.gg, mainly about terms of service, a recording pipeline in the installer and privacy policy (dated October 12).

brand_strength.rationale: Short evocative name with viral demand and mainstream gaming press, but press coverage is about trust and privacy concerns.

outcome_analysis: Melty is a Fall 2026 YC company, active and extremely early, built by a solo founder who previously ran a banned gamer AI coach. It gained viral attention with game mashups but drew backlash over terms of service and installer behavior, and it is repositioning toward RL and eval environments. No outcome exists yet; platform and IP risk are the main threats.
notes: Funding search found no rounds; Dealroom lists none. Founding year not stated by sources. Company copyright holder is Stella Montis Inc. Competitor dates are approximate. Competition listed as of Fall 2026 batch.
